gyms.name: Sundsvalls Klätterhall
gyms.notes: Opened May 2024 as part of Sundsvalls aktivitetshus; bouldering walls 2-4.5 m plus rope walls, weekly opening hours published. No map pin found in the page source.

gyms.name: KFUM Umeå Klättring och bouldering
gyms.notes: Volunteer-run hall with 5 m walls and wall cards on sale; the home page announces a free open-house bouldering day on 12 September 2026 at the address. The site loads a Google map plugin but no pin was found on the pages read.

gyms.name: Grepp
gyms.notes: Large climbing centre (about 3,000 m2) with 16 m rope walls and bouldering; opening hours published on the contact page. No map pin in the page source.

gyms.name: Campus1477 Blåsenhus (boulder wall)
gyms.notes: Borderline scope: university sports and fitness centre with a boulder wall by the entrance, open to members and to others for an admission fee, no booking. Likely category university; reviewer to decide whether a single boulder wall in a fitness centre qualifies.

gyms.name: Billingens Klätterklubb
gyms.notes: Club hall (rope wall with autobelays plus a boulder hall of about 40 running metres); access is for paid members through an RFID tag, 06-22 daily. No public drop-in found, so access is members-only. Address now confirmed on the club contact page (earlier only from a directory).

gyms.name: Ölands Klätterklubb
gyms.notes: Hall is open to non-members on Thursdays 18-20 (hours may differ, see Facebook); boulder wall open to all, green card needed for top-rope. The only map link on the site is a Google search link by address, no pin.

gyms.name: Karlskrona Bergsportförening (klättergymmet i Gräsvikshallen)
gyms.notes: Bouldering on low walls on the second floor of Gräsvikshallen (BTH sports hall); public drop-in Mon, Tue, Thu 18-21 and family climbing on Sunday, with a one-visit fee for non-members. The site map is an embed searched by place name, no pin coordinates.

gyms.name: Härnösands klätterklubb (klätterhallen Grottan)
gyms.notes: Two boulder rooms just over 4 m high and a 7 m rope wall; access is by month, half-year or year climbing cards (plus staffed open days), no single-visit price seen. No map pin on the pages read.

gyms.name: Hudiksvalls Klätterklubb (HUKK)
gyms.notes: Hall at Camp Igge Aren with a 13 m wall, boulder stand and a small boulder wall; try-out and member climbing. Opening hours say spring times are coming soon (stale), so open status is not confirmed. No map pin on the pages read.
